rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for the person or company responsible for building or improving a structure.

example.english: This contractor is responsible for building the new school.
example.traditional: 呢間承建商負責起新校舍。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 sing4 gin3 soeng1 fu6 zaak3 hei2 san1 haau6 se3

rows.note: Use this in an employment context for someone working independently rather than as a permanent employee.

example.english: I'm a contractor, so I only work when I get a job.
example.traditional: 我係自僱人士，接到工程先開工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 zi6 gu3 jan4 si6 zip3 dou2 gung1 cing4 sin1 hoi1 gung1

rows.note: Use this when the contractor is brought in by the main contractor for a specialized part of the construction work.

example.english: The main contractor brought in a contractor to handle the electrical work.
example.traditional: 總承建商請咗間分判商嚟做電線工程。
example.jyutping: zung2 sing4 gin3 soeng1 ceng2 zo2 gaan1 fan1 pun3 soeng1 lai4 zou6 din6 sin3 gung1 cing4
